title: 19 Bed Downtown Rooftop Gameroom Walk To Broadway
description:
Welcome to Nashville Knockout — a downtown home built for groups that want to be in the middle of Music City. 18 beds, 4 bedrooms, and a private rooftop with skyline views make it a great pick for bachelor parties, bachelorette weekends, birthdays, and family trips. Kick back in the open-concept living space, then walk to Broadway in minutes. Steps from the Ryman, Country Music Hall of Fame, and every downtown hotspot.

The space
This downtown Nashville home has room for the whole group and a layout built for hanging out together. Inside, you'll find modern decor, an open floor plan, and plenty of space to spread out without tripping over each other.

The main floor connects a comfortable living area to a fully equipped kitchen with an island — a natural hangout spot for group meals, movie nights, or getting ready before a night on Broadway.

Upstairs, the private rooftop has lounge seating and skyline views — a great spot for sunsets, late-night toasts, and group photos.

Sleeping: 18 Beds / 3 Bathrooms 

Bedroom 1 - 6 single beds

Bedroom 2 - 1 single, 1 full, 1 queen

Bedroom 3 - 2 queen, 1 full, 1 single

Bedroom 4 - 1 King

   +4 foldable single beds

Guest access
Guests have full private access to the entire home, all floors, the game room and the private rooftop deck. 

Free street parking is included. 

Self check-in via smart lock means you arrive on your schedule — no meet-and-greet required. Luggage drop and Early Check In is welcome for early arrivals and late departures (just message us to coordinate)

Other things to note
Neighborhood

You're staying in the heart of downtown Nashville — right in the middle of Music City, with Broadway's lights, live music, and energy just minutes from your front door. The area is walkable and active day and night. From your door, you can stroll to live music venues, top restaurants, cocktail bars, and major Nashville landmarks without needing a car.

Nearby hotspots include:

- Lower Broadway and the Honky-Tonk Highway — under 1 mile
- Bridgestone Arena — under 1 mile
- Country Music Hall of Fame — under 1 mile
- Ryman Auditorium — about 1 mile
- Nissan Stadium — about 1.3 miles (via pedestrian bridge)
- The Gulch — 1.5 miles
- 12 South — about 2.5 miles
